prompt: You are writing a booklet for someone who just completed a Feldenkrais ATM lesson. This section covers Part 3: Side-Lying Head Lift & Shoulder Differentiation. The steps in this part are: Lie on right
text: The teacher introduces the functional relationship between the neck and the upper back by asking you to slide the top shoulder forward as you lift and turn your head to look behind. This coordination reduces the effort required to move the head's weight, establishing a mechanical baseline for the more complex spinal rotations that follow.
